subject: [PATCH v3 03/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Requeue topology events only for busy devices

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mpt3sas driver to requeue topology events only for busy devices, rather than all non-zero return values from _scsih_add_device(). This change prevents unnecessary retries and potential data corruption when a device is not present or cannot be added. The driver now distinguishes between temporary failures that can clear with time (e.g., -EAGAIN) and permanent failures, and only retries the latter. Additionally, this patch fixes a bug where the driver could remove a drive even if it never disappeared.
